name: Like Clouds That Meet and Drift Apart
take: +16% Crit Rate flat, Swordlight Ward cap raised to two (and Heavy Stringblade grants an extra stack) — and then the real node: 25 stacks of Exorcising Seal on combat entry. Every Stringblade, mid-air or Transcendence basic that lands while she holds Seal consumes one and fires Juque Perdition — a 400% ATK Aero strike counted as Basic DMG, once per second — and each Seal consumed makes the target take 4% more from the next one for 2s. Twenty-five free sword-ghosts per fight, plus the 16% CR that lets the 4-cost go Crit DMG.

name: Like Petals That Fall Without a Sound
take: Heavy Stringblade +40% multiplier, and the Mindlock cap rises from 15 to 25 (Gathered Mind's cap too). Heaven's Clarity now stamps 6 Mindlock on every Heavy Stringblade cast — she opens the Transcendence window already well up the ramp. At 25 stacks the Forte amp alone reads +85%; this is the node that turns a good ramp into a wall.

name: Dreams Fade, Sword Abides
take: Liberation Crit DMG +100%, and during Heavy Stringblade she banks World in Chorus equal to the highest nearby Mindlock count — +3% Heaven's Reckoning multiplier per stack, spent on the cast. At the S2 cap that's +75% on the finisher. Gathered Mind also now applies 2 Tune Strain – Interfered, which feeds Mindlock right back into the loop. The guides' consensus best-value node.

name: Wherever the Road Leads, Side by Side
take: The team node. Any Resonator who inflicts Tune Strain – Shifting gets +20% ATK for 8s — her, Denia and Mornye all qualify, all rotation long. Not flashy. Just 20% ATK to the whole crew for doing what they were already doing.

name: Cold Steel That Longs to Warm the Snow
take: Severing Note: Judgement multiplier +100% — the gauge-filler becomes a real hit — and Sword Flight costs 30% less Flight Qi, which is a quality-of-life gift for the overworld more than the tower.

name: Cleanse This Tarnished Age, Till All Runs Clear
take: Targets take 40% more from Heavy Stringblade, Heaven's Reckoning and the Liberation — her three biggest numbers, amplified again. Her Interfered response gets 20% stronger. And Juque Perdition from S1 gets the full Mindlock treatment: during Heavy Stringblade she gains Exorcising Seal equal to the highest nearby Mindlock, and each stack amplifies Perdition by 2% (+5% on the first seven) — twice over, once from the Forte layer and once from To Know, To Banish. The sword-ghosts stop being chip and become a second damage profile.
